desc: 成衣水洗做旧的复古磨白质感，柔软落肩实穿版型，多色多件任选
leaf: 复古水洗做旧落肩圆领短袖T恤多件装
name: 复古水洗做旧圆领多件装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用无脸实穿正面交代版型与水洗色位
一秒讲清核心利益：成衣水洗带来的复古磨白与柔软垂感
放大廉价薄棉洗后走形、起球、色花的问题，衬托重磅水洗的耐穿感
一屏铺出全部水洗色位与可叠购件数，帮买家完成选色决策
复古街区实穿代入，让买家想象自己穿上的落肩松弛比例
微距证明成衣水洗的真实肌理与柔软手感，替代任何参数口号
用结构引线拆解领口、肩缝、侧片与下摆工艺，回答值不值这个价
shots.textZone: 四角引线末端各一枚圆角标签位：左上、右上、左下、右下，侧边留白承载

shots.intent: 并排解释洗水强度与色差是工艺结果而非质量问题，预先化解退货顾虑
shots.textZone: 每栏顶部一枚空白圆角标签位，栏间以炭灰细线分隔

shots.intent: 整叠件数与留空尺码表承接选码与多件决策，降风险收口
shots.textZone: 顶部标题带与三列表头为留白位，表体行为空白单元，不含任何数字

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots and construction screens, warm ecru paper #EFE6D9 for benefit, comparison and spec screens, weathered matte plaster in the same warm ecru #EFE6D9 family for lifestyle only
style.direction: vintage garment-washed apparel commerce, lived-in retro texture, catalogue-grade fit readability
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight charcoal #2D2D2D leader lines with dot terminations and empty rounded label pills only, no pictograms
style.lightingSystem: warm soft directional daylight from camera-left, low contrast, one gentle skimming component that opens the washed fabric texture, soft grounding contact shadow, no harsh specular and no glossy catalog sheen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent vintage garment-washed apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm ecru paper #EFE6D9, charcoal text and rules #2D2D2D and one faded-brick accent #B4614F; warm soft directional daylight from camera-left with a low-contrast skimming component that reveals washed fabric texture and a soft grounding contact shadow; backgrounds limited to seamless studio white, warm ecru paper and weathered matte plaster in the same warm ecru family; one modern geometric sans-serif with generous tracking for all lettering; thin single-weight charcoal leader lines and empty rounded label pills only; garments presented relaxed with natural drape, drop-shoulder seam readable, stable scale and centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no glossy catalog sheen, no invented fabric weights or certifications, no visible brand wordmark or style code.
noDrift: no invented fabric weight, composition, origin or certification claims
no visible brand wordmark, style code or neck-label lettering
style.presentationRules: garment shown relaxed with natural drape, drop-shoulder seam and hem line always readable, same silhouette scale and centering across the set, headless or neck-down cropping whenever a body is used
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm ecru paper #EFE6D9 boards and seamless white #FFFFFF studio paper; lifestyle ground is weathered matte plaster #EFE6D9
style.typography: single modern geometric sans-serif with generous tracking; all in-image wording carried only by short placeholder labels, never by dense body text
